options.systemPromptTemplate: You are an accounts-payable extraction system. Read the vendor email and attachment text and return the purchase order response as JSON matching the schema. Numbers are plain numbers (9648.00, not "9,648.00"). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Copy part numbers exactly as printed. If a field is genuinely absent use an empty string, 0, or an empty array; never invent values. Set extraction_confidence low when the text is ambiguous, truncated, or the totals do not add up. Today is {{ $now.toFormat('yyyy-LL-dd') }}.

parameters.query:
select p.po_number, p.vendor_id, v.name as vendor_name, v.email_domain, p.currency, p.order_date, p.status, p.total_amount,
  coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('line_no', l.line_no, 'sku', l.sku, 'description', l.description,
    'quantity', l.quantity, 'unit_price', l.unit_price, 'line_total', l.line_total, 'promised_date', l.promised_date)
    order by l.line_no) filter (where l.line_no is not null), '[]'::jsonb) as lines
from om_poc.purchase_orders p
join om_poc.vendors v on v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id
left join om_poc.po_lines l on l.po_number = p.po_number
where upper(p.po_number) = upper($1)
group by p.po_number, p.vendor_id, v.name, v.email_domain, p.currency, p.order_date, p.status, p.total_amount;

nodes.notes: SAP stand-in. Customer instance: SAP OData/RFC read of EKKO/EKPO, same output shape.

nodes.name: ValidationInput

nodes.name: CheckLine

nodes.name: GetValidationRules

assignments.name: detail_R6
assignments.value: ={{ $('CollectLineChecks').first().json.line_checks.filter(c => !c.empty).filter(c => c.qty_over).map(c => c.po_sku + ': qty ' + c.quantity + ' > ordered ' + c.po_quantity).join('; ') || 'OK' }}

assignments.name: detail_R7

assignments.name: pass_R8
assignments.value: ={{ ((v, sum, t) => v.doc_total !== null && Math.abs(Math.round(v.doc_total * 100) - Math.round(sum * 100)) <= Math.round(t * 100))($('ValidationInput').first().json, $('CollectLineChecks').first().json.line_checks.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.line_total || 0), 0), ($json.rules.find(r => r.rule_id === 'R8')?.threshold ?? 1)) }}

assignments.name: detail_R8
assignments.value: ={{ ((v, sum) => 'Total ' + v.doc_total + ' vs lines ' + sum.toFixed(2))($('ValidationInput').first().json, $('CollectLineChecks').first().json.line_checks.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.line_total || 0), 0)) }}

assignments.name: pass_R9
assignments.value: ={{ ((v, t) => v.po_found && v.doc_total !== null && v.po_total !== null && (v.po_total ? Math.abs(v.doc_total - v.po_total) / Math.abs(v.po_total) * 100 : (v.doc_total ? 100 : 0)) <= t)($('ValidationInput').first().json, ($json.rules.find(r => r.rule_id === 'R9')?.threshold ?? 1)) }}

parameters.content:
## 1. Intake

Vendor replies arrive in the AP mailbox (Outlook trigger, disabled on the lab). The fixture webhook plays the same role for testing. One Edit Fields per source maps it to the shared envelope; RouteAttachment sends a base64 PDF to the decoder, a binary PDF straight to the extractor, and plain text onward.

## 2. Decipher

Convert to File turns the base64 into a PDF, Extract from File pulls the text, and BuildDocumentText joins it with the email body. The Information Extractor reads that text against a fixed JSON schema (PO, vendor, lines, totals, self-reported confidence). No tools, no agent loop.

## 3. Match lines against the PO

The PO on record is fetched (SAP stand-in). ValidationInput holds the header facts. Split Out gives one item per extracted line, CheckLine finds its PO line and measures quantity and price drift, Aggregate folds the line checks back into one item.

## 4. Score against the rule table

The data table om_poc_validation_rules carries the nine rules (weight, hard, enabled, threshold) and the two settings AUTO_THRESHOLD and AI_WEIGHT. EvaluateRules gives one pass/detail pair per rule, ComputeDecision joins them to the table: score = 70% weighted rules + 30% model confidence, hard rules force review. Every attempt is logged and the caller gets the decision back.

## 5. HITL gate

Score >= AUTO_THRESHOLD with no hard failure posts automatically. Anything else emails the AP reviewer a side-by-side with Approve / Reject links and the execution waits on that click.

## 7. Failures

Every fallible node routes its error output here. Ops gets the error, the email subject and the execution id. Nothing is posted on a failure.

## 6. Convert and post

PrepareIdocFields sets the IDoc number and message type (ORDRSP / INVOIC / DESADV by document type), BuildIdocTree lays out ORDERS05 as JSON, the XML node renders it. The IDoc is queued for SAP, the Snowflake landing row is written, and the reconciliation is marked posted or rejected. AP gets one outcome email either way.

## Purchase Order Reconciliation

Decipher non-EDI vendor email responses (PDF or text), validate with business rules plus AI, gate on a HITL threshold, and post validated data as XML/IDoc to SAP and Snowflake. Native nodes only: no Code nodes, no community nodes.

Lab stand-ins and what the customer swaps:
1. WatchOutlookInbox: Outlook OAuth2 credential on the AP mailbox, plus a Get Attachment step before NormalizeOutlookEmail.
2. LmStudioExtractorModel: the approved LLM provider (Anthropic).
3. LookupPurchaseOrder: SAP OData/RFC read of EKKO/EKPO, same output shape.
4. QueueIdocForSap: HTTP Request to the SAP PI/PO or CPI IDoc endpoint, or the file port.
5. WriteSnowflakeLandingRow: the Snowflake node, same column list.

Tuning lives in the data table om_poc_validation_rules: weights, hard flags, enabled, per-rule thresholds, AUTO_THRESHOLD 0.90, AI_WEIGHT 0.30. Seed: scripts/seed-validation-rules.py.

Test: POST a fixture to /webhook/om-po-response (see data/fixtures). Mail lands in Mailpit at localhost:8025.
